clauses.name: Neutralize
clauses.printedParagraph: Neutralize a target card in the stack.

clauses.name: Deny
clauses.printedParagraph: Neutralize a target card on the stack unless its owner pays {H}{H}.

clauses.name: Ignore
clauses.printedParagraph: Cancel a target effect on the stack unless its controller pays {H}{H}.

clauses.name: Veer the Will
clauses.printedParagraph: Neutralize a target Will on the Stack. That Will returns to its owner's hand.

clauses.name: Compensate
clauses.printedParagraph: Neutralize a target Persistent Will on the Stack.

clauses.name: Compensate
clauses.printedParagraph: Its owner gains excess essence of Temperament and number equal to the Tribute cost of that card.

clauses.name: Imitate
clauses.printedParagraph: Copy a target Will on the stack. You can choose a new target for the copy.

clauses.name: Malaleuco, the Will-shaper
clauses.printedParagraph: As long as Malaleuco is in the Interzone, you can exhaust it to copy a Will on the stack that you control. You can choose a new target for the copy.

clauses.name: Scrambling Beacon
clauses.printedParagraph: Pay {H}{H}{H} and remove a Lucore counter: Change the target of a target card or effect on the stack that has as target a card on the field.

clauses.name: Nullifying Radiance
clauses.printedParagraph: Pay {H}{H} and remove a Flame counter: Cancel a target effect on the stack of the chosen temperament controlled by an opponent that targets a card on the field you control.

clauses.name: Wall off
clauses.printedParagraph: A target card on the Stack or on the field is Protected from cards and effects until the end of the turn.

clauses.name: Eorthoda, the Limpid
clauses.printedParagraph: If Eorthoda is used as tribute to play a Will from your hand, that Will cannot be neutralized. If it is a Persistent Will, it additionally enters the field with Protection from cards and effects controlled by the opponents until the end of the turn.

clauses.name: Simulacrum of Clemency
clauses.printedParagraph: Whenever an opponent plays a Will, you gain 5 Points unless that player decides to neutralize that Will.

clauses.name: Simulacrum of Clemency
clauses.printedParagraph: If a Will is neutralized this way, Exhaust Simulacrum of Clemency.

clauses.name: Simulacrum of Clemency
clauses.printedParagraph: As long as Simulacrum of Clemency is Exhausted, it has no effects.

clauses.name: Duel Honorably
clauses.printedParagraph: You may play this Will only before the Revelation.

clauses.name: Duel Honorably
clauses.printedParagraph: Players cannot put manifestations into Support until the end of the turn.

clauses.name: Duel Honorably
clauses.printedParagraph: A player may pay {H}{H} while this Will is on the stack to neutralize it.

resolvedRulings.rule: A copy is owned by its creator: Deny payment and Compensate printed-tribute refund go to that player.
Protection is intrinsic at tribute payment, without a separate Stack object.
Will copies are card tokens on the Stack, not detached effects. Persistent copies enter the field as tokens.

limits: Selected clauses and explicit branches only, not every interaction of the thirteen cards.
Core pending original actions are controlled fixtures; responses use production declarations, costs and Stack resolution.
Triggered tests also execute the public server declaration hook that produces tribute and Will-play triggers.
Eorthoda timing uses the atomic public declaration hook; a bare Session declaration does not invoke the public trigger producer.
Copied targets use production declarations; controlled pending originals isolate the selected interactions.
Automatic phase driving disabled in the real socket journeys. Physical devices and remote artwork are not certified.
